title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 3: The Mud

scenes.say: Training field. Recruits crawl under barbed wire, drag dummies, carry rifles through mud.
scenes.visual: recruits crawling under barbed wire through deep mud, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Sergeant Mack walks up on Ali.
scenes.visual: a drill sergeant walking toward a muddy recruit, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: You think the streets made you tough? The enemy don't care where you from.
scenes.visual: a drill sergeant's hat close up, rain dripping, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: You fight for the man next to you. Got it? Got it, Sergeant. Then show me.
scenes.visual: a recruit pushing to his feet in the mud, rifle in hand, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Every step in that mud, I was stepping further from who I used to be.
scenes.visual: muddy boots stepping forward, close up, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Night. Ali sits alone with headphones in, listening to an old voicemail.
scenes.visual: a recruit sitting alone on a bunk at night with headphones and a phone, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Baby boy, just checking in. I know you're doing good. I'm proud of you.
scenes.visual: a phone screen glowing in the dark showing a voicemail, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: His eyes well up. He presses delete.
scenes.visual: a thumb pressing delete on a phone, close up, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: It hurt too much to hear love when I didn't feel it for myself.
scenes.visual: a recruit sitting in silence in a dark barracks, head down, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Four. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a muddy training field at sunrise, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 3 of 25: The Mud. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
